verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents undetected-browser and stealth modes to bypass bot detection, plus persistent browser profiles with saved authentication states and session reuse. Together these let a crawl get past some anti-bot and login walls without re-authenticating each run. However, nothing in the pack shows CAPTCHA solving, automated login or form completion, or an agent handling these walls hands-free; JS execution is only a building block for that. missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA solving, automated login/form-fill flow without a pre-seeded profile, agent-driven wall handling, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: Undetected Browser Support: Bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
Hooks, proxies, stealth modes, session re-use—fine-grained control.
Browser Profiler: Create and manage persistent profiles with saved authentication states, cookies, and settings.
Managed Browser: Use user-owned browsers with full control, avoiding bot detection.
